name: Duel of the Set Hour
boxShape: a compact small square two-player intro box
clashArt: blindfolded verdigris-bronze Mnemarch priests pressing a glowing memory-crystal onto a bronze anvil to Set it, while eyeless ash-grey ember-cracked Iconoclast penitents charge in swinging glowing slag-picks to shatter it
contents: about ten bare unpainted plastic miniatures (a small starter warband for each side), a slim quick-start rules booklet, a few six-sided dice, and a small punch-out sheet of crystal and tide tokens
terrain: one press-out paper terrain piece — a single leaning salt-crusted shrine arch

name: Tide and Ledger
boxShape: a medium rectangular two-player battle box
clashArt: oilskin Brine-Factor corsairs poling tide-skiffs and hauling glowing crystals away to sell, as a translucent drowned-grey Sediment swarm of salt-dead rises out of the shrinking brine to smother them
contents: around twenty bare unpainted plastic miniatures split into two warbands, a full softback rulebook with a painterly cover, six-sided dice, a sliding tide-clock track, and a sheet of punch-out crystal objective tokens
terrain: two press-out cardboard terrain pieces — a stranded tide-skiff wreck and a cluster of salt-glass crystal formations

name: The Grand Litany
boxShape: a large deep premium collector's two-player box
clashArt: a vast clash across the drying flat under the swollen rust-red sun — blindfolded bronze Mnemarch bastions guarding a field of Set memory-crystals as an endless tide of drowned-grey Sediment salt-dead wades up out of the brine to re-dream them
contents: around forty bare unpainted plastic miniatures forming two full armies, a thick hardback rulebook, fold-out deployment map boards, measuring sticks, a generous pile of six-sided dice, and a full set of punch-out crystal and tide tokens
terrain: an array of press-out cardboard terrain — a ruined bell-tower tide-clock, a salt-shrine, and several towering crystal-cathedral formations
